Position: Project Administrator 
Type: Full-time 
Employer: Bespoke Consultants PTY LTD 
Location: Camberwell VIC 3124 
Salary: $75,000 - $95,000 p/a
About the Business: 
Bespoke Consultants Pty Ltd is an emerging professional services firm specialising in business strategy, digital transformation, and specialised consulting for the Defence and Public Sector ICT industries across Australia. With a strong reputation for delivering tailored, high-impact solutions, the company is known for its commitment to innovation, integrity, and client-centric outcomes. Bespoke Consultants fosters a collaborative, supportive workplace culture that values professional growth, work-life balance, and excellence in project delivery within a dynamic and purpose-driven environment.
About the Position: 
The Project Administrator plays a vital role in supporting the successful delivery of organisational projects at Bespoke Consultants Pty Ltd by coordinating activities, maintaining comprehensive documentation, monitoring performance, and facilitating effective communication across stakeholders, vendors, and cross-functional teams. This position is essential for ensuring projects in telecommunications, healthcare, and engineering environments are executed efficiently, on schedule, within budget, and in alignment with strategic objectives, contributing directly to the firm’s continued growth and client success.
Key Responsibilities:
•	Develop, maintain, and update project schedules, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), Cost Breakdown Structures (CBS), and resource plans using tools such as Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and Microsoft Excel.
•	Prepare weekly and monthly project reports, dashboards, and executive presentations to support visibility and informed decision-making.
•	Coordinate cross-functional teams, subcontractors, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure alignment, timely execution, and compliance with contractual requirements.
•	Monitor project budgets, timelines, risks, issues, KPIs, and performance metrics, including cost and schedule analysis.
•	Maintain structured project documentation and support tender processes, requirements gathering, contract administration, and PMO governance.
•	Facilitate project meetings, prepare agendas and minutes, track action items, and liaise with clients and vendors to maintain momentum and achieve quality deliverables.
Requirements:
•	Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
•	Diploma, Advanced Diploma, Associate Degree, or Bachelor degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent relevant industry experience).
•	2+ years equivalent relevant industry experience in project administration or project coordination, ideally across telecommunications, healthcare, or engineering sectors.
•	Strong skills in project scheduling, reporting, and documentation using Microsoft Project, Microsoft Excel, and Jira, with proven ability to develop dashboards and analyse data.
•	Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams, vendors, and subcontractors, along with excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
•	High attention to detail, strong organisational skills, ability to manage competing priorities, and working knowledge of Agile/Scrum environments.
•	Desirable: Exposure to large-scale or national-level projects, PMBOK, EVM (SPI/CPI), project claim management, feasibility studies, or PMP knowledge.
How to Apply: 
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

result.description:
We are looking for an experienced and strategic Cyber Security Architect to lead the design and implementation of advanced security systems across enterprise environments. This role is responsible for developing security architecture frameworks, identifying cyber risks, and delivering secure-by-design solutions that align with business goals and compliance standards.
The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in security controls, cloud security, enterprise infrastructure, and governance frameworks, and will play a lead role in defining the organisation’s cyber defence strategy.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-wide security architecture covering infrastructure, applications, data, identity, and cloud platforms.
Lead security assessments, threat modelling, and risk analysis during the solution design phase for new systems or services.
Define and implement security reference architectures and ensure adherence to frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, and Zero Trust.
Oversee the integration of security tools and controls across network, endpoint, identity, and cloud layers (e.g., SIEM, EDR, CASB, IAM, firewalls).
Collaborate with software engineers, DevOps teams, and cloud architects to embed security-by-design principles in SDLC and CI/CD pipelines.
Review security incidents and recommend architectural enhancements to improve resilience and reduce attack surfaces.
Develop and maintain policies, procedures, and architectural documentation, ensuring alignment with internal governance and external regulatory requirements.
Act as a key stakeholder in incident response planning, disaster recovery architecture, and business continuity strategies.
Provide technical guidance and leadership to security engineering and operations teams, and advise executives on cyber risks.
Liaise with vendors, regulators, and third parties to ensure security architecture is compliant and up to date with emerging threats.
Required Qualifications & Skills:
Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
5+ years of experience in cyber security with at least 2–3 years in security architecture or design roles.
Strong understanding of network security, encryption, identity management, cloud security (AWS/Azure/GCP), and endpoint protection.
Proficiency with security technologies such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, IAM, MFA, EDR, firewalls, VPNs, and vulnerability scanners.
Hands-on experience designing secure systems in cloud-native, hybrid, or on-premise environments.
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity standards and frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, ASD Essential Eight, OWASP).
Excellent documentation, stakeholder engagement, and risk communication skills.
Desirable:
Relevant certifications such as SABSA, CISSP, CISM, AWS Security, Azure Security Engineer, TOGAF.
Experience in Zero Trust Architecture, DevSecOps, or secure multi-cloud environments.
Background in regulated industries such as finance, healthcare, critical infrastructure, or government.
Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms, security automation, and SOAR tools.

Permanent Residents (PR) and Australian Citizens are eligible to apply
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $70,000 to $120,000 per year + Super

Type: Full-time
Employer: JG Prestige Auto Pty Ltd
Location: Clayton South VIC
Salary: $79,560 per annum
About the Business:
JG Prestige Auto Pty Ltd is an independent specialist workshop in Clayton South dedicated to Mercedes-Benz and other European vehicles. We deliver dealership-standard diagnostics, mechanical repairs, auto electrical work, air conditioning services and logbook servicing using advanced diagnostic equipment and high-grade parts. Our reputation is built on honest diagnosis, transparent upfront pricing, quality workmanship and a 24-month/20,000 km warranty. We value precision, clear communication and genuine customer care in a professional, well-equipped workshop environment that prioritises accuracy over shortcuts.
About the Position:
The Automotive Technician (Motor Mechanic) is responsible for diagnosing, maintaining and repairing Mercedes-Benz and European vehicles to a high technical standard. This hands-on role is central to delivering reliable, dealership-level service without the dealership price tag, ensuring vehicles leave the workshop performing safely and smoothly while supporting the growth of a specialist independent business.
Key Responsibilities:
Diagnose mechanical and electrical faults using advanced diagnostic equipment (including Xentry/ISTA and similar systems) and interpret live data and fault codes accurately.
Perform scheduled logbook servicing and routine maintenance to manufacturer specifications.
Repair and replace components including engines, transmissions, braking systems, steering, suspension, cooling systems, clutches and related mechanical assemblies.
Carry out auto electrical repairs, battery/charging system diagnostics, and air conditioning inspections, leak testing and re-gassing.
Dismantle, inspect, repair or replace worn or defective parts and reassemble components to correct specifications, referring to service manuals and technical data.
Road-test vehicles where required and verify repairs meet performance and safety standards.
Maintain a clean, organised and safe workshop environment, complete job cards accurately and communicate findings clearly to the business owner/customers.
Source and fit OEM or equivalent high-grade parts and support transparent quoting processes.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Certificate III in Automotive Technology, Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology, or an equivalent recognised qualification.
Minimum 4 years’ experience as a qualified Automotive Technician / Motor Mechanic.
Strong technical skills in diagnosing and repairing modern European vehicles, including familiarity with electronic control systems and diagnostic software.
Excellent attention to detail, problem-solving ability, clear communication skills and a professional, customer-focused approach.
Ability to work independently, follow manufacturer procedures, and maintain high standards of workmanship and workshop safety.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

The Whistler has become a vibrant destination known for its modern Australian menu, curated cocktails, and relaxed yet sophisticated atmosphere for Breakfast, lunch, and Dinner. The venue blends casual dining with elevated flair, offering everything from hearty brunches and share plates to evening gatherings that capture the essence of contemporary hospitality.

The Whistler is currently seeking skilled Cooks and Chefs to join its culinary team on a full-time basis. With competitive salaries ranging from AUD 75k to 85k per annum, depending on experience, this opportunity offers professionals the chance to contribute to a venue that values creativity, teamwork, and consistent quality.

Scope of the Work:
- Overseeing daily kitchen operations, including staff delegation, stock rotation, and maintaining accurate records.
- Preparing and cooking a variety of dishes, either regularly or for special functions and events.
- Managing production schedules and staff requirements to ensure timely service delivery.
- Estimating food supply needs, calculating costs for ingredients, and managing orders accordingly.
- Inspecting supplies, equipment, and work areas to ensure adherence to established quality standards.
- Analysing recipes and advising prices to menu items based on food, labour, and overhead costs.
- Working closely with team members to execute established recipes and menus with consistency and precision, ensuring alignment with seasonal availability and anticipated customer volume.

-Assist in onboarding, training, and supervising new team members, providing guidance and fostering a collaborative, efficient work environment.
- Monitoring and enforcing sanitation practices to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations, including Occupational Health and Safety (WHS) and HACCP.

- Be available on both days at weekends and be able to work split shifts.
- Have at least 2- 3 years of work experience as a Cook/Chef.

- Great work environment

Since 1981, Shadbolt Group has grown to become a leading cost-effective engineering solutions provider. We are proud of our professional performance on each and every project. Our aim is to build long term relationships with our clients based on trust, accountability and integrity. It is our dedication to quality that gives our clients a competitive advantage.

This goes hand in hand with our diligence and engineering excellence. From pipework projects to tank manufacturing, structural works, machine building or site work. Shadbolt Group is committed to providing prompt and precise delivery from our highly trained team of experts. The requirements of each client are always the focus of everything we do.

We are seeking qualified Pressure Welders to join our growing professional team. We seek reliable, team-oriented individuals with high integrity who will positively contribute to the company's success. We offer short-term contracts with above-award pay rates fully guaranteed under current workplace regulations.
Position available across our site and work locations in NSW, SA, WA and VIC.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to determine and perform appropriate welding techniques for the task at hand
Set up equipment and weld parts, using appropriate pressure welding equipment and methods
Examine welds for width of bead, penetration and precision, and performs necessary repairs or reworks
Weld and repair pressure vessels and pipes to relevant high-quality standards and ensure conformance with standard specifications
Fabricate metal components in accordance with supplied drawings and specifications
Conduct tests on welds to ensure there are no leaks in the pressurised systems
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Apply post-weld treatments to relieve stress and enhance the strength of the welded joints on pressure-containing equipment
Diagnose faults and perform operational maintenance on machines and equipment in order to restore full functionality and safety performance, maintaining a condition that does not compromise safety
Maintain tools and equipment to a professional standard
Keep the workstation clean and orderly to retain a safe and operational work environment
Clean and prepare metal surfaces for welding by flame cutting, heat cutting, gouging, bevelling, grinding or filing
Manage workflow, meet deadlines, and troubleshoot problems on a daily basis, in addition to fabrication duties

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade qualified
Minimum of three years of experience in this role or similar
Ability to work independently and in a team environment to complete large and complex projects
Critical thinking
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Precision skills
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Safety focus
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
